description: Use this when the user wants a link they can share so that investors can ask to join a class of one of their funds. Starts a new shareable invite link, with a label and an expiry if they give one. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed link for the user to confirm; once confirmed, the reply gives the link’s address. This call creates nothing.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their own words

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York

name: capital_company_create_invite_link
title: Create a shareable invite link
